content.scope: Long-lived assets to be held and used (PPE, finite-lived intangibles). Excludes goodwill (ASC 350), indefinite-lived intangibles.
content.when_to_test: When events or circumstances indicate carrying amount may not be recoverable
impairment_indicators: Significant adverse change in use or physical condition
Significant adverse change in legal or business climate
Expectation asset will be sold or disposed before end of useful life

step_1_recoverability.test: Compare carrying amount to sum of UNDISCOUNTED future cash flows
step_1_recoverability.key: Undiscounted cash flows (no PV calculation in step 1)

step_2_measurement.calculate: Impairment loss = Carrying amount - Fair value
step_2_measurement.fair_value: Determined using market price, comparable transactions, or PV of future cash flows (discounted)
step_2_measurement.recognize: DR Impairment Loss (income statement), CR Asset (or Accumulated Impairment)
step_2_measurement.new_basis: Fair value becomes new cost basis

example.step_1: $500K carrying > $450K undiscounted cash flows → Not recoverable, proceed to step 2
example.journal_entry: DR Impairment Loss $100K, CR Equipment (or Accumulated Impairment) $100K
example.new_carrying_amount: $400K (cannot be increased later even if FV recovers)

classification_criteria: Management commits to plan to sell
Asset available for immediate sale in present condition
Active program to locate buyer initiated
Unlikely significant changes to plan will be made
assets_held_for_sale.measurement: Lower of carrying amount or FV less cost to sell
assets_held_for_sale.depreciation: STOP depreciating once classified as held for sale

discontinued_operations.separate_component: If asset held for sale represents component with discrete operations and cash flows
discontinued_operations.presentation: Report in separate section of income statement (below income from continuing operations)

cpa_exam_tips: Step 1 (recoverability): UNDISCOUNTED cash flows vs. carrying amount
Step 2 (measurement): FAIR VALUE (discounted often) to calculate loss
Held for sale: Stop depreciation, lower of CA or FV-costs to sell
Don't confuse with goodwill impairment (different test)

key_points: Test for impairment when indicators present
Step 1: Recoverability test using undiscounted cash flows
Step 2: If not recoverable, impairment = CA - FV
Held for sale: Stop depreciation, measure at lower of CA or FV-cost to sell
